rule: Use only saved naturally generated computations. Freeze three previously named donor traces: the original correct reference (historical native reference profile), the early fitted failing weight-swap control and the native original unfitted failing profile. Both failing donors subtract at downhill and at friction. Each donor supplies two named single events one native prediction before the already annotated actual applications; everything else in its complete decode is background. These are supervised reference examples. Query annotations never enter scoring. Remove every donor sharing the query initial kinetic energy and downhill work. Query group information is used solely for disjoint evaluation. Distances use two consecutive FF20 turn vectors to preserve the prior geometry. Primary contextual matcher applies prefix dynamic programming from the beginning of each decode to all donor endpoints; diagonal edges carry weight two and horizontal and vertical edges one. Normalize by the fixed sum of prefix lengths. Comparator is the identical two-turn cost without the rest of the prefix. Nearest distance over all donor endpoints and donors yields downhill, friction or background. Also record forced two-class decisions, distances and nearest native endpoints. No scan stops early and no labeled query event/window enters the prediction. At every predicted downhill event use the prior consensus downstream score (43 merges), without its old FF20 gate. Positive score means a candidate correction. Compare errors, correct descents, friction, unannotated and alternative events separately. Source bank, exclusions and measures fixed before query results. Single row before the operator, not the displayed sign, is the primary evaluation unit; score the whole response and retain all alerts. Treat any causal or independent-capability deletion/edit claim as unmeasured.
physical_contrasts: Score all exact one-factor drop and friction variants within the 30 authorized originals, compare full-merge directional turn changes per joule at the two roles, preserve pair context and qualify identifiability where input factors or route differ.
